 Step Number: 8
 Reason for Mistake: They incorrectly inferred the “non-giver” by subtracting the set of recipients from all employees, which identifies who did not receive a gift, not who failed to give one. They also relied on heuristic gift-to-recipient matches without extracting actual gift assignments, compounding the error. The result misidentified Rebecca as the non-giver, whereas the correct answer is Fred.
